nlmixr2plot events for loggers

Source: vignettes/events.Rmd
events.Rmd

rxode2 provides a small event bus: packages that finish a top-level piece of work announce it with rxode2::rxEventEmit(), and any package can listen with rxode2::rxEventListen(). The main consumer is nlmixr2log, which records fits, simulations and their results, but you can write your own listener. See ?rxode2::rxEventListen for the full API.

Two rules of the bus matter here:

  • Events are delivered only from the outermost operation. Every emitting function opens an operation scope, and an event is delivered only when no scope is active, so work done inside another operation is silent.
  • Emitting is a no-op when no listener is registered, and nlmixr2plot checks that the bus exists before using it, so with an older rxode2 nothing changes.

This vignette describes what nlmixr2plot itself emits.

What nlmixr2plot emits

nlmixr2plot emits a single event, fitResult, when one of these functions returns successfully:

Function kind fit data
plot() of a fit (plot.nlmixr2FitData()) "plot" the fit NULL
vpcPlot() "vpcPlot" the fit (see below) NULL
plot() of an augPred() object (plot.nlmixr2AugPred()) "augPredPlot" NULL the augPred() data

The fitResult payload fields are:

Field Contents
fit The fit the plots belong to, or NULL for plot(augPred(...)).
result The value the function returns: the ggtibble::gglist of plots from plot(fit) or plot(augPred(...)), or the ggplot from vpcPlot() (the vpc database with vpcdb = TRUE).
kind "plot", "vpcPlot" or "augPredPlot".
call The call, normalized by rxode2 so its head is the kind (e.g. plot(fit), vpcPlot(fit, n = 5) or augPredPlot(ap)) and large inlined values are replaced by markers.
data For "augPredPlot" only, the augPred() data that was plotted; otherwise NULL.

Details:

  • One event per call. The event is emitted when the function exits, after all the plots are built.
  • vpcPlot() and supplied simulations. When vpcPlot() is given a vpcSim() result instead of a fit, the fit field is the fit that simulation came from, not the simulation.
  • plot(augPred(...)) has no fit. An augPred() object does not carry its fit, so fit is NULL and the plotted data is sent as data; a logger such as nlmixr2log uses it to find the run it belongs to.
  • Nothing on error or empty results. If the function fails, or returns NULL, no event is emitted.

What is not emitted

Everything that happens inside these functions is silent:

  • The simulation that vpcPlot() runs (through nlmixr2est::vpcSim() and rxode2::rxSolve()) emits no solveComplete.
  • Plots made internally, such as the traceplot() inside plot(fit), emit no events of their own.
  • Calling these functions from inside another operation scope (for example, from a function wrapped in rxode2::rxEventScope()) emits nothing; only the outermost operation reports.

Other events you may see around plotting come from other packages: nlmixr2est emits fitComplete when nlmixr2() finishes a fit and solveComplete from augPred(), simulate(), predict() and vpcSim() called at the top level. Those require an nlmixr2est with event hooks; nlmixr2plot does not emit them.

Listening to the events

A listener is a function function(event, ...); the payload fields arrive as named arguments. Here is a small listener that records what it sees. First fit a small model:

library(nlmixr2plot)
library(nlmixr2est)
#> Loading required package: nlmixr2data

one.cmt <- function() {
  ini({
    tka <- log(1.57); tcl <- log(2.72); tv <- log(31.5)
    eta.ka ~ 0.6; eta.cl ~ 0.3; eta.v ~ 0.1
    add.sd <- 0.7
  })
  model({
    ka <- exp(tka + eta.ka)
    cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl)
    v <- exp(tv + eta.v)
    linCmt() ~ add(add.sd)
  })
}

fit <- suppressMessages(
  nlmixr2(one.cmt, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "posthoc",
          control = list(print = 0))
)

Then register a listener and make some plots:

seen <- list()
rxode2::rxEventListen("demo", function(event, ...) {
  p <- list(...)
  seen[[length(seen) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
    event = event,
    kind = if (is.null(p$kind)) NA_character_ else p$kind,
    hasFit = !is.null(p$fit),
    resultClass = class(p$result)[1],
    call = paste(deparse(p$call), collapse = " ")
  )
})

p <- plot(fit)
v <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(vpcPlot(fit, n = 50)))
ap <- suppressMessages(augPred(fit))
a <- plot(ap)

rxode2::rxEventUnlisten("demo")
do.call(rbind, seen)
#>           event        kind hasFit     resultClass                 call
#> 1     fitResult        plot   TRUE          gglist            plot(fit)
#> 2     fitResult     vpcPlot   TRUE ggplot2::ggplot vpcPlot(fit, n = 50)
#> 3 solveComplete     augPred  FALSE  nlmixr2AugPred         augPred(fit)
#> 4     fitResult augPredPlot  FALSE          gglist      augPredPlot(ap)

plot(fit) and vpcPlot() each report one fitResult, and the simulation inside vpcPlot() stays silent. plot(ap) reports a fitResult with no fit. With an nlmixr2est that has event hooks, the top-level augPred() call also reports a solveComplete (emitted by nlmixr2est).

After rxEventUnlisten(), plotting reports nothing:

n <- length(seen)
p <- plot(fit)
length(seen) == n
#> [1] TRUE

Full logging

For a complete record of fits, simulations, updates and the plots made from them, use nlmixr2log, which listens to all of these events (including fitResult from nlmixr2plot) and stores the plots with the run they belong to.
